Subject: Virtual onsite: Redwood Full Loop (multi-slot) — availability + next steps

Hi Owen —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. We’d like to invite you to a virtual full interview loop with the product & infra teams at Redwood. The loop is organized as four focused slots (~40 minutes each) so we can keep individual interviews tight and leave a 15–20 minute buffer between sessions for quick breaks and any tech hiccups.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Slot A: 2025-12-11 09:00–09:40 (product design deep-dive)
- Slot B: 2025-12-11 10:00–10:40 (system design / infra)
- Slot C: 2025-12-11 11:00–11:40 (team fit & execution)
- Slot D: 2025-12-11 13:00–13:40 (culture / leadership panel & close)

If any of those times conflict, tell me the windows that work best for you on that day and we’ll try to adapt. We expect two interviewers per slot; total loop will be ~3.5 hours including buffers.

I’ve attached your resume (for our internal packet) and the candidate-facing interview packet (high level agenda + tech logistics). We’ll send formal calendar invites once you confirm a preferred slot pattern.

Anything you want to prep or questions in advance? We don’t run a take-home for this role — just be ready for a short design prompt.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Karthik
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
(karthik_iyer@redwood.com)

Attachments: owen-park-resume.pdf, interview-packet-zenith-fullloop.pdf

Thanks — quick internal note before we finalize.

Summary of constraints:
- We need to avoid interviewer overlap: Marcus and Niharika are on PTO that day; remove them from panel.
- For Slot A (product design) we want a PM + TL combination; Marissa, can you take PM slot A in case you’re available?
- For Slot B (infra), I’ll cover system design; prefer someone from Runtime (Laura, can you pull in a second infra interviewer if possible?)
- Slot C (team fit): keep it lightweight — one hiring manager + one peer. Marissa, do you have a preferred peer to add?
- Slot D (culture panel): Laura + me, and please leave the last 10 minutes for a casual Q&A.

Debrief plan:
- Short async scorecard to be completed within 24 hours of the last interview (we’ll use the linked Greenhouse note).
- Assign debrief lead: Marissa as hiring manager will collate notes and run the 30-min calibration the next morning if any scores diverge by >2 points.

I’ll also include a 15-min buffer between C and D for any carry-over. Once Owen confirms availability we’ll send invites and an .ics.

Thanks — Sergio
